artworks.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Elizabeth and John the Baptist (La Madonna della Scodella)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows four figures gathered closely together. The person on the far right is an adult woman, positioned in profile with her body facing left, her head turned slightly to look at the child on her lap. She has her hair styled in waves and wears a draped garment with flowing fabric. The central figures include a toddler sitting on the woman's lap, their curly hair and round face slightly turned towards another child close by. The other young child has similar curly hair, with features partly visible as they engage with the toddler. Both children are unclothed, except for drapery covering parts of their bodies. Behind them, an older woman wears a head covering with a detailed face, including a prominent nose and distinct eyes. She has her right hand raised, palm facing forward. The background is crosshatched, providing a textured, neutral backdrop to emphasize the figures.

artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black and brown
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Alice Clement
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the descent from the cross. The drawing shows several figures interacting with a large cross as they lower a body down from it. The central cross is emphasized with shading and linework. Other figures are depicted in various poses around the central action. The background contains simple landscape elements. The use of contrasting lines highlights details in the scene.

artworks.title: View of the Acropolis
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The view from an elevated vantage point shows a historical site with the Parthenon in the distance. The Acropolis and its rocky terrain dominate the scene, with ancient structures visible. The image is a detailed lithograph or sepia-toned illustration with brush or pen strokes defining the architecture. The color palette includes browns, grays, and beiges. Smaller structures and trees are present, casting shadows on the ground.

artworks.title: Propylaeum
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor heightened with white over black chalk and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with ancient ruins viewed from a lower angle. The ruins dominate the composition, likely part of an ancient Greek temple. The horizon is positioned in the upper portion, with the top of the structure and distant sky visible. The brushstrokes capture texture and wear of the stone columns, with subtle shading for depth. The color palette consists of muted earth tones like beiges, grays, and hints of blue. Two figures in period clothing stand near the monument, surrounded by stone remnants and a rocky surface. More ruins are hinted at in the distance on the left side.

artworks.title: House of Heinrich Schliemann
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level view with an ornate, multi-story building on the right side. The building features neoclassical architecture with statues on the rooftop. The perspective is angled, showing the façade and one side of the building with arched windows and intricate detailing. The horizon is partially obscured by the building and lacks distinct elements. The brushstrokes are fine and precise, capturing the building's intricate designs. The color palette is subdued with primarily sepia tones. Pedestrians in period clothing are seen on the street, and lush trees line the edges, adding a natural contrast.

artworks.title: Theater of Herodes Atticus
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk heightened with white
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient stone structure in the distance, with arched openings dominating the upper part of the scene. In the foreground, cattle stand on a path, with trees scattered around them. A figure, potentially a herder, is on the right side. The painting has fine brushstrokes, detailed leaves on the trees, and a color palette of soft browns and grays.

artworks.title: Monument of Philopappos
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient ruin seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon line is low, with the hill and the remnants of the building in the upper part of the image. The ruin seems to be part of a larger archway or monument, with decorative carvings and niches housing sculpted figures. The brushwork appears sketch-like, capturing details and textures with careful line work and shading. The color palette is primarily in sepia tones, creating a historic feel. The earthy color contrasts with variations of gray and beige. A small figure stands to the right, seemingly admiring the monument. Patches of grass and rocks surround the ancient site, providing context to the weathered surroundings.

artworks.title: Old Market Gate
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image depicts ancient ruins with classical columns and a partly damaged architrave at street level. The horizon line is low, revealing the tops of buildings behind the columns. The brushstrokes capture fine details realistically, with a sketch-like quality in monochrome tones. The color palette is muted, using shades of sepia or brown-gray. Three figures stand closest to us, suggesting human scale and interaction. More buildings are visible in the distance, hinting at a bustling surrounding area.

artworks.title: Temple of Olympian Zeus
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk with touches of graphite
artworks.dimensions:
image (lunette): 15.3 x 15.5 cm (6 x 6 1/8 in.)
sheet: 15.9 x 15.9 cm (6 1/4 x 6 1/4 in.)
support: 48.8 x 33.7 cm (19 3/16 x 13 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins with towering classical columns as the main focus. The perspective is from ground level, looking towards the columns with a low horizon. The background includes more ancient architecture and trees, but these elements are subdued compared to the columns. The brushwork is detailed with clear lines and shading to capture the columns' designs. The color palette is muted with earthy tones like sepia. People are gathered close to the viewer, providing scale to the columns. In the distance are smaller trees and architectural elements, suggesting it is part of a larger historical area.

artworks.title: University
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk heightened with white and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image features a neoclassical building with a colonnaded facade, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The building is central in the frame, with a mountainous landscape in the distance to the right. Delicate brushwork is used to capture architectural details in fine lines. The color palette is muted, with shades of brown, beige, and gray. In front of the building, a carriage is pulled by horses, and figures are scattered around, alongside lush vegetation.

artworks.title: Nike Temple
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over touches of graphite
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 27.5 x 16.7 cm (10 13/16 x 6 9/16 in.)
support: 48.8 x 33.7 cm (19 3/16 x 13 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of an ancient temple viewed from a slightly elevated and angled perspective. The structure's architectural details are prominent, with a clear sky and a low horizon showing a landscape in the distance. The temple is depicted with precise lines showcasing classic architectural elements. The artwork uses a sepia color palette, emphasizing shadow and light play. In the bottom right corner, there is a circular inset featuring two men in traditional attire.

artworks.title: Tower of Winds
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over touches of graphite and black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a historical building with an octagonal structure in the center. The structure is made of stone blocks, adorned with carvings near the top, with a partially gated entrance facing towards us. To the left are residential buildings with shuttered windows and archways. A palm tree is visible on the right, and the sky has soft clouds. The horizon is not clear, but it appears above the central structure. The artwork is in a monochromatic sepia palette with a mix of soft and bold brushstrokes for texture. Light and shadow in the brushstrokes create depth and showcase the stonework craftsmanship. An iron fence guides the viewer's eye into the scene.

artworks.title: Observatory
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over touches of black chalk and graphite heightened with white
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with an architectural structure resembling a small observatory or temple with a dome on a hill. The scene features rocky terrain, detailed textures in vegetation and architecture, a predominantly sepia-toned color palette, and a cloudy sky. In the foreground, tall spiky plants frame a path with a young girl standing on it.

artworks.title: Parthenon, Inside
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite heightened with gray
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins, possibly a Greek temple, viewed from ground level leading towards large columns ahead. The horizon is at eye level, with the temple standing against rolling hills and distant clouds. Detailed brushstrokes create textures in the stone and sky. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily in shades of grey and beige. Boulders and scattered stones suggest remnants of the structure, with a figure walking among them. In the distance, more columns can be seen aligned with the main structure.

artworks.title: View from the Old Royal Palace of the Hermesstreet
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite heightened with gray
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a tree-lined avenue from an elevated viewpoint. The scene includes buildings, mountains in the distance, fine brushstrokes detailing trees and structures, a limited sepia color palette, a child on the path, figures in traditional attire moving towards a central fountain, and a mix of architectural and natural elements.

artworks.title: The Propylaeum from the East
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image depicts a ruins site viewed from a distance. Central to the composition are ancient columns, some of which remain standing while others lie broken. The horizon is positioned low, drawing attention to the sky above scattered with clouds. The brushstrokes appear deliberate, capturing details of the stone structure and terrain. The color palette is muted, consisting of sepia tones and shades of gray. Distant hills are visible in the background. Scattered rubble and detailed textures on the stones close to us add to the scene's authenticity and depth.

artworks.title: The Parthenon from the East
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with ancient ruins seen from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high, with the sky taking up a large portion of the scene. In the distance, classical ruins, such as columns and structural remnants, rise on uneven terrain. The artwork seems to utilize a wash or ink drawing technique with smooth brushstrokes indicating shadows and architectural details. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly in sepia and soft grays. Close to the viewer, there are scattered rocks and sparse vegetation, adding to the desolate feeling. The ruins become more defined and concentrated as they extend into the distance, conveying a sense of decay and grandeur.

artworks.title: Temple of Hyphaestus
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite heightened with gray
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient city landscape with classical ruins, including the Acropolis with its famous structures like the Parthenon in the distance. The scene includes a variety of buildings, temples, cypress trees, and figures dispersed among the rocky terrain. The painting uses earthy brown and gray tones with nuanced brushstrokes for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Academy
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of a classical architectural setting with structures resembling ancient Greek temples. The horizon aligns with the rooftops of the buildings. Flanking the central structure are two statues on tall columns. The soft, detailed depiction features muted shades of beige and gray, resembling a sepia-toned sketch. Small figures in period attire are dispersed on the ground level. The buildings and statues continue into the distance with a consistent architectural rhythm. The monochromatic color palette, use of light and shadow, and lightly clouded sky emphasize the grandeur of the scene.

artworks.title: The Acropolis from the West
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and traces of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image displays an ancient hilltop structure, likely the Acropolis, at a commanding point of view in the middle distance. The ruins dominate the horizon, positioned high in the composition, giving a backdrop to the classical architecture. A distinctive temple, possibly the Parthenon, rises on the right side on a craggy cliff. The brushwork of the image employs fine, precise strokes, reminiscent of ink drawing techniques, accentuating the stonework's textures and the detailed landscape. The color palette is limited, likely utilizing sepia tones and shades of grey, creating a historical ambiance. Below the ancient edifices, a path winds through a landscape populated with scattered trees and bushes. Close to us, small figures and horse-drawn carriages can be seen moving about, adding a sense of scale and life to the scene.

artworks.title: Monument of Lysicrates
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image displays a sketched view of an ancient circular structure with classical columns and a sculpted entablature. The viewpoint presents a full view of the structure, with a hill in the distance on the left. The sketch uses dark ink washes and light tones on parchment to depict the texture of the stone and architectural details. The color palette is mainly grayscale and beige. Other buildings and a hillside are faintly visible in the background, partially obscured by sketched foliage.

artworks.title: Erechtheion
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows ancient architecture from a slightly elevated perspective. The structure's grandeur and detail are captured. The horizon is not visible. The walls of the building dominate the upper part of the scene, with large stone blocks forming a silhouette against the sky. The brushstrokes are precise, contributing to the sense of solidity and historic grandeur. The color palette is subdued, with shades of sepia and gray highlighting the stone's texture and age. The ground is scattered with stones and sparse vegetation. In the distance, smaller stone structures are visible. A figure stands to the right of the structure.

artworks.title: Hadrian's Arch
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image is a sepia-toned drawing featuring an ancient stone arch structure with columns and detailed stonework. Other elements include small buildings, trees, a townscape, mountains in the background, and additional ruins above the mountains. The drawing employs delicate and precise brushstrokes to capture intricate details of the architecture and landscape with a faintly textured technique. The color palette consists of soft browns and grays.

artworks.title: The Harbor of Piraeus
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite heightened with gray
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic view from an elevated perspective, overlooking a city, port, and mountainous landscape. Rocky terrain with grazing goats leads into agricultural fields and the city. The city is dense with buildings, becoming more compact near the coastline where a busy port with ships is situated. Mountains are visible in the background. The artwork uses detailed brushstrokes to capture architectural and natural details. The color palette is sepia-toned, creating a vintage ambiance and emphasizing the contrast between urban development and natural scenery.
